verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a public REST API. It has an API reference with key-based authentication and an API quickstart that verifies a key, gets an agent, places a call and fetches the transcript. Specific endpoints are documented, such as POST /agent/{agent_id}/extraction-categories and the agent create/update APIs, and workflows are described as driven entirely through the Bolna API. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation of API usage beyond first-party docs.
